name: The Answer Hidden in the Spread

system.flavor:
Read the spread a second time and a friend gets another try at a moment they fumbled: the lockpick that slipped, the jump that fell short, the toast that landed wrong, the knot tied in the wrong order. They must take the second answer.

Not enough to undo what has already happened or help more than one.

body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: The target rolls a Combat Card, before spending Surges. Response (unopposed): It may reroll one die and must use the new result, then recalculate its Success Die and generated Surges.

surges.html: It may ignore one ordinary -1 Success Die penalty on that card.
After that card, the target may move 1 unit. No additional Action is granted.
